instruction: Turn off the "ctrl+b" keybinding for toggling the sidebar visibility in VS Code to prevent unintended sidebar actions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Ctrl+B shortcut for workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility. Evaluator checks for the disabling entry in keybindings.json. Similar complexity - single keybinding removal.
